parishInfo.name: San Lorenzo Ruiz Parish
parishInfo.parishPriest: Rev. Fr. Alberto G. Cahilig, OMI
parishInfo.parochialVicar: Rev. Fr. Alvin Vicente C. Barretto, OMI

officeHours.notes: Parish office transactions, certificate releasing, and booking verifications occur strictly during regular office hours.

massSchedule.notes: There is NO 9:00 AM Sunday Mass. Nearest morning slots are 8:00 AM and 10:00 AM. Schedules are subject to liturgical feast updates.

confessionSchedule.location: Confessional Area near the Sacred Heart Shrine
confessionSchedule.sickCalls: Available anytime by emergency appointment through the Parish Office (0997 742 8176).

schedulingRules.conflictRule: An existing booking at 9:00 AM blocks 9:00 to 10:00 AM. 9:30 AM is not available. 10:00 AM is the next available time.
schedulingRules.reschedulingPolicy: Submitted requests cannot be rescheduled through the system. Cancellations and urgent changes must be referred to the parish office at 0997 742 8176.

requestStatuses.Pending: Amber - Under initial review. Verifying documents and payment.
requestStatuses.Processing: Blue - Being coordinated or encoded. Checking registry books or priest availability.
requestStatuses.Completed: Green - Finished. Signed PDF downloadable in My Requests or ready for pickup.
requestStatuses.Rejected: Red - Declined or needs correction. Read admin remarks, fix issue, and resubmit.

requirements: Full legal name, active mobile number, active email address
Complete home address and Chapel / GKK / BEC
One valid government-issued ID (Driver's License, Passport, PhilID/National ID, UMID, Postal ID, PRC ID, Voter's ID, SSS ID; max 5MB)
Live selfie taken during registration (to match ID)
registration.rejectionHandling: Check remarks in SMS/email. Common causes: blurry photo, selfie mismatch, address mismatch. Resubmit with clear ID and selfie. Call 0997 742 8176 if needed.

paymentOptions: Cash on pickup at Parish Office
GCash to Agnes Calapaan (0997 742 8176), enter reference number and upload receipt screenshot
generalRequirements: PSA of the person on the record
Full name of person on record and approximate date or year of sacrament
Full names of parents (including mother's maiden name)
certificates.marriagePurposeAnnotation: For church wedding, Baptismal and Confirmation certificates must carry annotation 'For Marriage Purposes' and be issued within the last 6 months.

wedding.leadTime: File at least 2 to 3 months before wedding date.
wedding.feePolicy: Wedding fee is not published online. Refer to parish office at 0997 742 8176.
requirements: PSA Birth Certificates of groom and bride
PSA CENOMAR issued within the last 6 months
Updated Baptismal Certificate annotated 'For Marriage Purposes' (within 6 months)
Updated Confirmation Certificate annotated 'For Marriage Purposes' (within 6 months)
Pre-Cana Marriage Seminar Certificate
Canonical Interview with Parish Priest
Publication of Marriage Banns for 3 consecutive Sundays in both home parishes
Civil Marriage License (or Article 34 Affidavit of Cohabitation if living together 5+ years)
BEC / Chapel recommendation from local leader
CO Permit to Marry (if military or police)
Principal Male Sponsor (Ninong) & Principal Female Sponsor (Ninang) names and origins

baptism.leadTime: Register at least 1 to 2 weeks before baptism date.
baptism.feePolicy: Baptism fee is not published online. Refer to parish office at 0997 742 8176.
requirements: Photocopy of child's PSA or Local Civil Registrar Live Birth Certificate with registry number
Photocopy of parents' Catholic Church Marriage Certificate (if church-married)
Chapel recommendation from local GKK / Chapel leader
White Cards / seminar slips of parents and principal godparents
Attendance at Pre-Baptismal Seminar (held on scheduled Saturday mornings)
Godparent Rule: At least ONE fully initiated, practicing Catholic godparent (Ninong or Ninang) who has received Confirmation

funeral.leadTime: Coordinate with parish office immediately upon passing (Hotline: 0997 742 8176).
funeral.feePolicy: Funeral Mass fee is not published online. Refer to parish office.
requirements: Official PSA or Local Civil Registrar Death Certificate
Cemetery Burial Permit and coordination time
Full name of deceased, birth date, date of passing, and civil status
Place of burial / cemetery
Preferred Funeral Mass schedule (parish church or home wake blessing)

anointingOfTheSick.availability: Available at any time for dangerously ill, major surgery preparation, or advanced age.

blessings.feePolicy: No mandatory fixed fee. Voluntary free-will love offering according to your means.
blessings.leadTime: Submit request at least 1 week in advance.
requirements: Exact physical address with landmark directions (or vehicle plate number and model)
Preferred date and 1-hour time slot
Contact person name and reachable mobile number
